now.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
now.text: Darren Cross, as M.O.D.O.K., hunts Janet van Dyne in the Quantum Realm.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hank's wife, whom Cross hunts in the Quantum Realm.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hunts Janet in the Quantum Realm as M.O.D.O.K.

proposed.text: Darren Cross, now Kang's M.O.D.O.K., is the hunter sent after Scott and Cassie in the Quantum Realm. He later brings down the ship Janet's family escaped in, leaving Hank to die.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hank's wife, whose family Cross hunts for Kang in the Quantum Realm.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Kang's M.O.D.O.K., who hunts Janet's family in the Quantum Realm.

changes.evidence: In Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania, M.O.D.O.K. is sent after Scott and Cassie (Janet learns at Krylar's that a hunter was sent after them) and later attacks Krylar's ship with Hank aboard; Kang himself captures Janet. Neither the film plot nor the M.O.D.O.K. or Janet pages show M.O.D.O.K. hunting Janet.

now.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
now.text: Kang forces Scott Lang to steal his power core by threatening Cassie. Scott later fights him and helps trap him in the Quantum Realm.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The man Kang forces to steal his power core, who later helps trap him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The conqueror who threatens Cassie to make Scott steal his power core.

proposed.text: Kang forces Scott Lang to steal his power core by threatening Cassie. Scott later fights him and, with Hope's help, punches him into the collapsing core.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The man Kang forces to steal his power core, who later punches him into it.

changes.evidence: At the end of Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania, Hope blasts Kang and Scott punches him into the unstable Multiversal Engine Core, which collapses and destroys him (Wikipedia: they throw Kang into the power core, destroying them both). Scott does not trap him in the Quantum Realm; that was Janet, years earlier.
